options.description: Free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours

fare_difference.applies_to: voluntary rebooking on a higher-fare flight that is not airline-caused

allowed_agent_actions: Rebook the customer on the next available flight within 24 hours at no charge when the disruption is airline-caused
Issue meal vouchers and lounge access according to the delay compensation rule
Arrange hotel accommodation for the delayed-hours portion when the delay qualifies
Initiate a refund request for an airline-caused cancellation
Provide the customer's own booking and flight status information
escalation_required_for: Compensation beyond the stated policy amounts
Waiving a fare difference above INR 1,500
Exceptions for non-airline-caused disruptions, such as a customer missing the flight
Refunds to a payment method different from the original payment method
